Руфлоксацина Гидрохлорид C17H18FN3-O3S,HCl = 399.9. CAS — 101363-10-4 (rufloxacin); 106017-08-7 (ru- floxacin hydrochloride). ATC — J01MA10. ATC Vet — QJ01MA10. (rufloxacin) Profile Rufloxacin is a fluoroquinolone antibacterial with properties similar to those of ciprofloxacin (p.243). It is given orally as the hydrochloride in the treatment of susceptible infections in a usual initial dose of 400 mg on the first day followed by 200 mg daily thereafter. A plasma half-life of 30 hours or more has been re- ported.
